description: Is Dø Desktop running on the user's Mac, and can it put edits into their Logic project? Reports which sessions it holds, how it applies edits (apply_mode "reopen" = save, back up, close, apply, reopen), whether macOS lets it (logic_control), each session's last apply (reopen_results) and its applied cursor. Use it to know whether an edit will reach the project now or wait for the next session open. When it is NOT connected the result says how the user gets and pairs the app, and what still works without it. Read-only.
name: doseedo_desktop_status
